- lvl:definite_assignment@L1#1 | level L1 way states_the_rule: Every access of a local variable must be preceded by an assignment on every possible path, or the program does not compile. The analysis ignores run-time values, except for constant booleans and the operators && || ?:.

After a declaration with no initializer the variable is unassigned, and an assignment makes it assigned on that path.
